descriptor.scene: A FULL ROOM JOINED BY LIGHT is the subject. The ordinary room at night, warm lamps on, a dozen founders in small knots across the whole floor, talking, demonstrating, laughing. Among them: MAYA (sage-olive blazer), CHRISSY (cream blazer), the ENGINEER (charcoal hoodie), GARY (light-wash denim jacket, yellow smiley patch left chest, orange pixel-mascot patch right chest) mid-conversation at center, and DAVID KOBROSKY at the right guiding one founder toward another. Between the knots of people, faint warm hand-painted threads of soft gold light arc gently from group to group at head height, sparse, five or six threads at most, reading as connection rather than technology. No neon, no holograms, no interface elements. The threads stay subtle; the people stay the subject.
descriptor._caption: Here is why it becomes the most valuable community in the world, and it is not the money. Every member's hardest-won lesson becomes every member's starting point. A thousand startups learning together compound faster than any company can learn alone.
descriptor.anonymous: a dozen founders filling the room in small knots, varied builds and skin tones
